The Freak Circus

Download Now

《 The Freak Circus 》 

Of horrors

The Circus of Horrors has arrived in town.

Uncover its secrets and face the terror it hides, all while being led by Pierrot, the silent yandere, or Harlequin, his seductive rival.

Don’t be fooled by their smiles, they’re not what they seem.

You work at a café, and one day, on your way to work, fate leads you to cross paths with Pierrot. That’s when his obsession begins. But he’s not alone,  his stage rival decides to join the game, turning this twisted dance into a dangerous competition… all for you

Warning: This game is intended for ages 18+. The yandere theme includes dark elements, strong language, and sensitive graphic content.

For now, the game has all character introductions done. The rest is still being developed.

《 Current Features 》

  • Original Artwork and BGs
  • 5 Characters
  • 1 Bad ending
  • Available languages: English, Portuguese (BR) and Chinese


《 What is planned? 》

  • Pierrots ending
  • Harlequin ending
  • Protagonist's ending
  • All together (Mc with both, Pierrot and Harlequin )

The script is still a work in progress, so no endings are fully planned yet.
For now, after finishing the current version of the game, the story continues for one more in-game day  which is still in development.


《 Content warning 》

  • Screen shaking 
  • Blood,  Death,  Murder and Gore
  •  Allusions to cannibalism 
  • Abuse 
  • Strong language 
  • Kidnapping 
  • Non-consensual use of drugs
  • Physical domination
  • Mild physical harassment / non-consensual physical contact


《 Credits 》

Created by: Neko Bueno
Voice Acting: Darthsuki
Final Review: Yuçuna
Chinese Translation:  copiklaGrogu
Kinetic Text Tags: Wattson
SFX and Music: https://pixabay.com and YouTube Audio Library


《Official Note 》


Hello! You can call me Neko Bueno.
I'd like to clarify that this is the only official page for the game. The only other official sources are my social media accounts, listed below.

Please do not reupload or repost the game on other websites or platforms.
This can be really harmful to indie creators, and I kindly ask for your understanding!

One exception: I’ve given copiklaGrogu permission to translate the game into Chinese, so it’s perfectly fine to check it out there as well!

And please, feel free to create fanart, fanfics, and gameplays!
I truly love seeing every single one of them. I only ask that you credit the official page (e.g. link to this page on description) when sharing.

Thank you so much for all your support!
Enjoy the show
I will continue working on the next part soon.
